priority: move four existing release candidates into free external testing without adding spend or creating new concepts

games.title: Balance Drop
games.short_description: Place falling weights across a beam, manage torque, and survive increasingly tight balance rounds.
games.description: Balance Drop is a one-tap strategy game built around short replayable runs. Place incoming weights across a seven-slot beam, control torque, clear twelve-drop rounds, and chase a higher score as the safe zone gets tighter.

games.title: Catch Drop
games.short_description: Drag the catcher, collect falling orbs, dodge spikes, and push your high score as the speed rises.
games.description: Catch Drop is a fast one-finger arcade game. Move the catcher, collect green and gold orbs, avoid red spikes, and stay alive as the spawn rate and fall speed increase. The loop is designed for instant retry and score sharing.

games.title: Cipher Sprint
games.short_description: Break four-digit ciphers from exact and misplaced clues before the 90-second clock expires.
games.description: Cipher Sprint is a timed code-deduction game. Build four-digit guesses from digits 1–6, use exact and misplaced clues to narrow the answer, solve as many codes as possible in 90 seconds, and replay for a higher score.

games.title: Orbit Align
games.short_description: Rotate three orbital rings and align every marker with its target using as few moves as possible.
games.description: Orbit Align is a compact rotational puzzle with twenty levels. Rotate three rings, line up the cyan markers with their amber targets, minimize moves, and progress through increasingly varied alignments with replay and share hooks.
